== Summary ==
Slip “•Wuta” cut unchanged from page 7 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 986, 1624, 1261)). Version [[Wuta (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
